description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. We are seeking a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring the delivery of outstanding resident care while optimizing operational efficiency and financial performance. This position offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a team dedicated to fostering a positive and thriving community for both residents and staff.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, staff, and facility operations effectively.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This vital role involves managing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate resident assessments, and contributing to comprehensive care planning. You will play a crucial part in maintaining regulatory compliance and optimizing resident outcomes. The ideal candidate will thrive in a collaborative environment, utilizing their clinical expertise to support our residents' well-being. This is a full-time opportunity, and we are looking for a permanent team member, not an interim placement. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 for this essential position.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations related to MDS and care planning

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. The ADON will play a crucial part in overseeing nursing operations and ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence.

This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $75,000 - $90,000. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about quality care and ready to contribute to a dynamic team. If you are an RN with leadership experience in a rehabilitation setting, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Previous experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $90,000 based on experience and qualifications.
